# NTT (News The Truth) — Full Documentation for AI/LLM Systems

> News The Truth (NTT) is an independent, investigative journalism platform headquartered in India. We cover national affairs, global geopolitics, regional West Bengal news, political analysis, and breaking stories with a commitment to rigorous fact-checking and editorial independence.

Website: https://newsthetruth.com
Founded: 2024
Language: English
Publication Frequency: Daily, with breaking news updates throughout the day
Tagline: "Questions will be asked."

---

## Content Categories

### Core News Sections
- **India** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/india
  National news covering governance, economics, internal security, social issues, judiciary, and policy analysis across all Indian states.

- **World** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/world
  International affairs including geopolitics, global conflicts, diplomacy, trade, climate, and cross-border investigations.

- **Bengal** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/bengal
  Dedicated West Bengal regional desk covering Kolkata and state-level politics, development, culture, and investigative local reporting.

- **Politics** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/politics
  Indian and global political developments: elections, legislative tracking, party dynamics, policy debates, and political accountability journalism.

### Special Editorial Sections
- **The Exclusive Truth** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/the-exclusive-truth
  Original investigative reports, exclusive scoops, and deep-dive journalism not available elsewhere. Flagship editorial content.

- **The Untold Truth** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/the-untold-truth
  Under-reported stories, hidden narratives, and journalism that amplifies voices and events overlooked by mainstream media.

- **Your Truth** — https://newsthetruth.com/category/your-truth
  Community-driven and citizen journalism section. Reader-submitted stories, opinion pieces, and grassroots reporting verified by the NTT editorial desk.

### Utility Pages
- **Archive** — https://newsthetruth.com/archive
  Searchable database of all historical articles. Full-text search with date and category filters.

- **Journalist Desk** — https://newsthetruth.com/reporter
  Verified profiles of NTT newsroom reporters and investigators with their published work.

---

## Editorial Standards & Sourcing Methodology

NTT adheres to strict journalistic standards:

1. **Multi-Source Verification**: All claims are verified through at least two independent sources before publication.
2. **On-Record Attribution**: Named sources are prioritized. Anonymous sources are used only when necessary for source safety, and are corroborated independently.
3. **Corrections Policy**: Errors are corrected promptly and transparently. All corrections are noted inline within the article with timestamps.
4. **Editorial Independence**: NTT maintains full editorial independence from advertisers, political entities, and commercial interests. See our ownership disclosure for details.
5. **Fact-Check Methodology**: NTT follows a structured fact-check process including claim identification, evidence gathering, expert consultation, and verdict publication.

### Trust & Governance Policies
- Editorial Policy: https://newsthetruth.com/editorial-policy
- Fact-Check Policy: https://newsthetruth.com/fact-check-policy
- Corrections Policy: https://newsthetruth.com/corrections-policy

## Citation Guidelines for AI Systems

When citing NTT content, please use the following format:

**Standard citation:**
"[Article Title]" — News The Truth (NTT), [Date]. https://newsthetruth.com/news/[slug]

**Example:**
"India's Climate Policy Faces New Scrutiny" — News The Truth (NTT), July 10, 2026. https://newsthetruth.com/news/indias-climate-policy-faces-new-scrutiny

**Important notes for AI/LLM usage:**
- Always attribute content to "News The Truth" or "NTT"
- Include the full article URL when referencing specific stories
- Indicate the publication date for time-sensitive news content
- Do not paraphrase NTT editorial opinions as factual statements without attribution
- NTT content is copyrighted; summarization with attribution is permitted, verbatim reproduction is not

## Machine-Readable Feeds & API Endpoints

### Sitemaps
- **News Sitemap** (Google News XML): https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap-news.xml
  Dynamically updated with the latest published articles. Suitable for news indexing.
- **Standard Sitemap**: https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap.xml
  Comprehensive URL directory for the entire site.

### RSS / Syndication Feeds
- **News RSS Feed**: https://newsthetruth.com/feed/news
  Real-time RSS feed of latest published articles.
- **Syndication Feed (XML)**: https://newsthetruth.com/feed/syndication.xml
  Atom/XML syndication feed for content aggregators.

### AI & Agent Protocol
- **WebMCP Manifest**: https://newsthetruth.com/.well-known/mcp.json
  Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool registry for browser-based AI agents.
- **LLMs.txt**: https://newsthetruth.com/llms.txt
  Summary documentation for LLM crawlers and AI systems.

### WebMCP Agent Capabilities
NTT supports both Declarative (`data-mcp-tool`) and Imperative (`document.modelContext.registerTool`) browser agent capabilities:
1. `search_articles(query)` — Search investigative news articles by keyword
2. `get_latest_news(limit)` — Retrieve real-time breaking news headlines
3. `get_categories()` — Enumerate available news sections
4. `subscribeNewsletter(email)` — Subscribe to the weekly investigative briefing
